diagnosis.original_evidence: R30ClassifyScreenSpacePass returns None for the exact direct C993 centre when original-game raw WVP proof is absent, but R33Dispatch previously branches to R33TryFastWorld on all R30 None results before trying lower R29.
source_trace: D3A5/C993 lens centre producer attaches exact WorldBillboard semantic.
R30 returns ExactLensCentreWorld only when original raw game c64/shader/pose/source checks pass.
R33 previously tried generic fast world on None or lower R29 after unhandled exact HUD stereo.
diagnosis.root_cause: The upper R33 generic-world fallback did not retain the R30 source-owner rejection for the original C993 centre; an absent WVP proof could be reinterpreted as authorization for generic spatial stereo.
alternatives_rejected: Suppressing the centre/sun pixel or broadening HUD admission would hide effects or flatten actual 3D geometry.
Increasing c64 freshness window does not prove the write belonged to the same source call or pose.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Exact central source and R30 stereo classification now prevent both unproven and unhandled C993 draws from passing into generic world or lower R29; bounded original draw path and static+portable route regressions added.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Positive cases preserve exact source when evidence is absent or stereo unhandled; negative cases leave CABE/unrelated world alone and allow successfully handled exact centre to follow existing per-eye implementation.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R30 accepts exact source-owned game WVP for the direct C993 centre; R33 owns the physical left and right submissions only when exact stereo is handled. Otherwise one original game draw is preserved instead of using unowned cached per-eye world WVP.
